Bhubaneswar Ekamra: Temples and Urban Sacred Landscape

A three-hour heritage walk in Bhubaneswar, Odisha

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you relate temple building forms to a living sacred landscape.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Old Town orientation and street map
  • Selected temple exteriors subject to worship rules
  • Bindusagar public viewpoints
  • Architectural comparison notes

How the time is spent

  1. Old Town orientation and street map 30 min

  2. Selected temple exteriors subject to worship rules 45 min

  3. Bindusagar public viewpoints 55 min

  4. Architectural comparison notes 50 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.

Where
Bhubaneswar, Odisha
For
Individuals, families, schools, colleges, private groups and visitors from abroad
Length
About 3 hours
When
Any day you choose. Early morning is best in the warmer months.
Led by

Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Meeting point
Agreed with you. A map location is shared once the date is confirmed.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
